exposure: genital herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection during pregnancy
outcome: prevalence of genital HSV infection among pregnant women
adherence to preventive measures for vertical herpes transmission
cohort: Neonatal and maternal HSV infections in the Netherlands between 1999 and 2015
finding: Neonatal herpes incidence in the Netherlands slowly increased over the last 15 years, potentially due to an increased genital HSV prevalence during pregnancy or decreased guideline adherence by healthcare professionals.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, a preventive measure for vertical herpes transmission, was less commonly reported by healthcare professionals in 2012-2015 compared with 2006-2011.
